## 文化依据与风险

- [青岛市南区文化馆：青岛贝雕五代人的岁月传承](https://www.qdsnqwhg.cn/html/feiwuzhiwenhuayichan/feiyihuodong/2024/1230/5239.html)：支持青岛贝雕、贝料加工及看盘等文化关联，不证明画中为具体作品。

原创贝片帆船、海景与灯塔不对应现存作品或具体真实地点。以下风险仍需实际遮罩检查：
- 主帆和船体可能在青岛狭颈、海湾凹口或轮廓外被切断，必须检查真实遮罩。
- 原设定的贝雕看盘未明确出现；不可把图声称为具体贝雕看盘或传承人作品。
- 标签覆盖、邻区配色、手机尺度尚待原SVG实拼验证。
- 数据的行政边界、地图审定与公开许可尚待核实。

## 实际完整提示词

### A 水墨
Use case: stylized-concept. One complete square Qingdao cultural artwork for an internal experimental Shandong map. INPUT IMAGE 1 is the actual Qingdao outline template, supplied only as a spatial guide: the entire square reference including its margins is the entire output canvas, with no crop, zoom, repositioning or distortion. A separate precise vector mask will later cut the artwork to the referenced shape. Do not trace, paint, preserve or include the irregular geographic outline, flat fill, template margin or any city boundary. Paint a complete seamless square to all edges. Place the main visual motif in the wide UPPER interior area of the reference, not in the lower narrow tail: its recognition core near normalized full-canvas x=0.471, y=0.310. The primary artwork is an original imaginary Qingdao shell-inlay decorative viewing plate featuring a strongly legible single sailboat design: a broad clear sail, hull, and shell pieces, not dependent on hairline rigging. The plate may spread beyond the conservative core, but avoid having its essential sail or hull extend into the outline's concavities. Keep it readable rather than a tiny isolated badge. This is creative artwork inspired by the Qingdao shell-carving tradition, not a copy of any existing shell artwork, historical vessel, or photograph. Imagined sea, wind and shore are secondary. All content is imagined. No text, numbers, signature, watermark, seal, legend, labels, UI, map or frame. Style A: expressive Chinese ink-and-wash on visible xuan paper; coastal ink blues and deep ink with restrained pearly light, graceful wet/dry brush strokes, subtle negative-space sail and varied tonal washes. Maintain artistic unity across the whole square, with dark blue wave gestures and paper texture naturally continuing to all edges; not photoreal or glossy CGI.

### B 工艺融合
Use case: stylized-concept. One complete square Qingdao cultural artwork for an internal experimental Shandong map. INPUT IMAGE 1 is the actual Qingdao outline template, supplied only as a spatial guide: the entire square reference including its margins is the entire output canvas, with no crop, zoom, repositioning or distortion. A separate precise vector mask will later cut the artwork to the referenced shape. Do not trace, paint, preserve or include the irregular geographic outline, flat fill, template margin or any city boundary. Paint a complete seamless square to all edges. Place the main visual motif in the wide UPPER interior area of the reference, not in the lower narrow tail: its recognition core near normalized full-canvas x=0.471, y=0.310. The primary artwork is an original imaginary Qingdao shell-inlay decorative viewing plate featuring a strongly legible single sailboat design: a broad clear sail, hull, and shell pieces, not dependent on hairline rigging. The plate may spread beyond the conservative core, but avoid having its essential sail or hull extend into the outline's concavities. Keep it readable rather than a tiny isolated badge. This is creative artwork inspired by the Qingdao shell-carving tradition, not a copy of any existing shell artwork, historical vessel, or photograph. Imagined sea, wind and shore are secondary. All content is imagined. No text, numbers, signature, watermark, seal, legend, labels, UI, map or frame. Style B: sophisticated handmade Chinese shell-inlay / shell-carving imagery, with layered real-looking but illustrated mother-of-pearl fragments, directional pale nacre texture, subtle sea-blue, shell-white and a small warm-pink accent. Show the graphic sailboat as a beautiful coherent part of the shell-inlaid viewing plate; texture should read like made-by-hand craft rather than a plastic or generic 3D wallpaper. Let broad wave forms, softened shell fragments and handmade fibers carry the artistic scene right across all four edges, without a pasted-on map or circular badge.
